mapper.select: SELECT AVCI.MNG_INST_CD ,AVCI.CLCT_DT ,AVCI.VDS_ID ,AVCI.LANE_NO ,AVCI.AVG_SPEED ,AVCI.TRFVLM ,AVCI.OCCP_RT FROM BIGDATA.EXT_ADSI_VDS_COLCT_INFO AVCI INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(AVCI.CLCT_DT) AS CLCT_DT ,VDS_ID ,LANE_NO FROM BIGDATA.EXT_ADSI_VDS_COLCT_INFO AVCI WHERE AVCI.VDS_ID = #{vdsId} GROUP BY VDS_ID, LANE_NO ) RCT ON AVCI.CLCT_DT = RCT.CLCT_DT AND AVCI.VDS_ID = RCT.VDS_ID AND AVCI.LANE_NO = RCT.LANE_NO WHERE AVCI.VDS_ID = #{vdsId} GROUP BY AVCI.MNG_INST_CD ,AVCI.CLCT_DT,AVCI.VDS_ID ,AVCI.LANE_NO ,AVCI.AVG_SPEED ,AVCI.TRFVLM ,AVCI.OCCP_RT
